result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.select_edges_by_node()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Select all edges connected to specified nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5595-L5660){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.select_edges_by_node(nodes) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Selects all edges where at least one endpoint is in the provided node list. For directed graphs, includes both incoming and outgoing edges. Useful for selecting the local connectivity around specific nodes. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int | str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of node IDs (int) or labels (str) whose incident edges should be selected. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Selecting "B" pulls in every edge that touches it -- both `A-B` and `B-C`, but not the unrelated `C-D` edge: ::: {#151242bf .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="D") ) b_id = graph.get_id_from_label("B") graph.select_edges_by_node([b_id]) graph.count_selected_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: Labels work just as well as IDs: ::: {#360e3c00 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="D") ) graph.select_edges_by_node(["B"]) graph.count_selected_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
